text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The group began to climb the Tower of Luna. Inori tried to take the lead, giving instructions to Muimi and {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルナの塔を登り始めた一同。
イノリは主導権を握ろうと、
ムイミと{0}へ指示を出していた。

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Are you listening? When exploring an unknown place like this, the most important thing is to proceed with caution!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいですか？　
こういう得体の知れない場所を探索する上で、
一番大事なのは、
慎重に進むことです！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Onii-san and Muimi, make sure not to do anything rash! If you were to fall onto a trap in such a place, you'd probably be dead on the spot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄さんもムイミも、
うかつな行動を取らないように！
こういうところで罠にはまったら、
一発でお陀仏ですからね！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Who even has the time to worry about such troublesome matters! If there's a trap, we just have to dodge it, right? Come on, let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな面倒なことやってられるか！
罠があったらよけりゃいいだろ？　
さあ、
行くぞ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Wha-...?! Muimi?! Wait! It's dangerous to step on tha~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁっ！？　
ムイミ！？
待つですよ！　
そこは危な──

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! Whatever happens, I'll sort it out somehow──... Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配するなって！
なにがあったって、
アタシがなんとかしてやる──
あれ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Just now... I feel like I stepped on something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今、
なにか踏んだような……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: ...PIIIIIIIIII!? A-AHEAD! LOOK AHEAD, YOU TWO!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ぴいいいいいっ！？
前、
前見るですよ、
二人とも！？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What's with that huge iron ball?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おわっ、
なんだあのデカい鉄球！？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: No matter how you look at it, isn't this your fault for stepping on a trap!? A-Anyway, let's run!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう考えてもおまえがトラップ踏んだせいですよ！？
と、
とにかく、走るです！！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: DOHYAAAAAA!
text_block_list.orig_text: どひゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: PIIIIIIIII!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぴぃぃぃ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! Why don't you listen to what I say!? You Dumbuimi! Thanks to you, look what happened...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くうぅ……！　
なんであたしの言うこと聞かねえですか！？
このバカムイミ！　
おかげでこんな目に……！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Stupid?! I'm not stupid, don't call me that. If I'm one then you're... an idiot! Inoridiot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
バカって言うな、
バカって！
じゃあオマエは……
アホだ！　
アホイノリ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Are you a kid?! I shouldn't have teamed up with a small-time scoundrel like you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガキですか、
おまえは！？
おまえみたいなちびっ子悪党なんかと
組むんじゃなかったですよ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: What?! Who are you calling "small-time"?! You're the last person I want to hear that from!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なあっ！？　
誰がちびっ子だ！
オマエにだけは言われたくないっての！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Right! Then we'll go left, everyone! Follow me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし！　
左へ行くぞオマエたち！　
ついてこい！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: If you're going left, then I'm going right! I'd rather be alone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっちが左ならあたしは右です！
一人の方が
まだマシですからね！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: She went off alone...?! Geez, we can't go back now, so it can't be helped! Let's just split up for the time being!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイツ、
一人で行ったのか……！？
もう戻れないし、
仕方ない！　
ここはいったん二手に分かれるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: *pant pant*... Hey, are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁっ……
おい、
オマエ。
大丈夫か？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I know what you're going to say. You're worried about Inori.
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってるって。
イノリが心配だって言いたいんだよな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...What happened earlier was my bad. I didn't listen to her warnings and stepped on a trap.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……さっきのは
アタシが悪かった。
アイツの言うこと聞かないで、
罠を踏んだりして。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...A long time ago. I promised Inori that we would go on an adventure together someday. Well, I don't think she currently remembers that promise, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……昔さ。
イノリと、
いつか一緒に冒険しようって約束したんだ。
まあ、
アイツはそんな約束覚えちゃいないだろうけど。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: To think I was finally able to fulfill what I told her... but like this it's not going to work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく約束を果たせたってのに……
こんなんじゃ
駄目だよな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's go, then! To find that cowardly Big Boss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ！　
じゃあ行くか！
あのビビりなビッグボスのとこに！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, that Muimi. I would've never expected her to be so thoughtless!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ったく。
ムイミのヤツ。
あそこまで考えなしだとは思わなかったです！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: If I'm teaming up with an idiot like that, no matter how many lives I have, they won't be enough! I'm relieved we managed to part ways quick enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんなバカと組んでたら、
命がいくらあったって足りないです！
こうして別れてせいせいするですよ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Now! I'll take the treasure all for myself, and--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
あたし一人で、
華麗にお宝を手にいれてやると──

text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: PIIIIIII?! Wh-What was that roar just now?! A monster?! Is it a monster?! It has to be a monster, doesn't it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぴぃ！？　
な、
なんですか今の鳴き声！？
魔物！？　
魔物ですか！？　
魔物ですよね！？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: O-On hindsight... Walking around such a tower alone... might be pretty dangerous...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よ、
よくよく考えてみれば……
一人きりでこの塔を歩くのって……
相当ヤバいかもですよ……！？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: AWAWAWAAWA...?! I-I have to hurry and meet up with Muimi and Onii-san...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あわわわわっ……！？
は、
早くムイミたちと合流しないと……！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: PYAAAAAAAAAH!? IT HAS APPEARED!? S-Someone...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぴゃあああああっ！？　
出たーっ！？
だ、
誰か──

text_block_list.text: ...Show yourself, Spiresbane Blade!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──現出せよ、
天楼覇断剣！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待たせたな！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Ge... GEEZ! You sure took your time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た……
たくっ！　
遅いですよ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Don't be like that! I was in a hurry, you know? ...Sorry about earlier.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言うなって！　
これでも急いだんだぞ？
……さっきは
悪かったな。

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: ...W-Well..! If you're so humbly apologizing, I guess I CAN forgive you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……まあ。
謝るんなら、
許してやってもいいですけど？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Haha, thanks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ、
ありがとな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Whether it's you or me... if we're alone we can't go onwards, can we? So let's go together! You'll be the brains. I'll be the brawns!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なぁ。
アタシだけでも、
オマエだけでも、
先に進めないだろ。
だから、
一緒に行こう！
オマエが頭脳担当。
アタシが戦闘担当でな！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Mm... I-I suppose it can't be helped. S-Since you're insisting... I guess I can team up with you again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
む……
し、
仕方ないですね。
そこまで言うんなら……
また組んでやってもいいですよ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, glad to be onboard! ...But I should warn you, I'm quite the wild horse!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
よろしくな！
……ただし、
言っとくけど
アタシは相当なじゃじゃ馬だ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: If you're really going to call yourself "Bis Boss"... you'd better be able to reign me in properly, Inori!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビッグボスを名乗るなら……
ちゃんとアタシをコントロールしろよな、
イノリ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Hmph, who do you think you're talking to?! Having enough experience with Kaya-pi already, I'm used to dealing with simpletons!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんっ、
誰に向かって言ってやがるですか！
こちとらカヤぴぃで単純バカの扱いは慣れてるですよ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: I'll work you to the bone as much as I can, Muimi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せいぜいこき使ってやるですよ、
ムイミ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, the Big Villain and the future Big Boss teamed up again to explore the Tower of Luna.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして、大悪党と未来のビッグボスは、
改めてルナの塔探索のため、コンビを組むのだった。
